One Pan Peanut Chili Oil Noodles

Comment “YES” and I’ll send you the full recipe card WITH INSTRUCTIONS!!

Thick, chewy noodles tossed in a rich, spicy peanut chili oil sauce with garlic, sesame seeds & fresh green onions…

For the Noodles:
1 serving thick, hand-cut noodles (or any noodles you like)

For the Peanut Chili Oil Sauce:
1 tbsp peanut butter 2 tbsp chili flakes (optional) 4 green onions, sliced 4 tbsp sesame seeds 4 cloves garlic, minced 1 tbsp chili oil crisp 1 tbsp rice vinegar 1/2 tbsp dark soy sauce 1/4 cup neutral oil (I use avocado oil) Reserved pasta water, as needed

For Garnish:
Sliced green onions Extra sesame seeds (optional)

Instructions:
Cook noodles according to package instructions. Before draining, reserve some pasta water
Add sliced green onions, minced garlic, sesame seeds, chili flakes & chili oil crisp to a heat-safe bowl
Heat neutral oil in a small saucepan until hot, then carefully pour over the aromatics to release their flavor
Stir in peanut butter, rice vinegar & dark soy sauce until everything is well combined
Add the cooked noodles to the sauce and toss until evenly coated, adding a splash of reserved pasta water as needed to loosen the sauce
Garnish with sliced green onions and extra sesame seeds. Serve immediately!

Loaded Steak Baked Potato

Comment “YES” and I’ll send you the full recipe WITH INSTRUCTIONS for FREE!!

Crispy baked potato loaded with juicy garlic butter steak, creamy Dijon sauce, quick-pickled onions & a crispy-edged fried egg…

For the Steak:
1 thin-cut ribeye or New York strip
Salt & black pepper
1 tbsp butter
1 garlic clove

For the Creamy Dijon Sauce:
2 tbsp Greek yogurt
1 tbsp mayonnaise
1 tsp Dijon mustard
1 tsp lemon juice
Salt & black pepper, to taste

For the Quick Pickled Onions:
1/4 red onion, thinly sliced
2 tbsp rice vinegar or white vinegar
1/2 tsp honey
Pinch of salt

For the Loaded Potato:
1 large russet potato
1 tsp olive oil
Salt
1–2 tbsp butter
2 eggs
Fresh chives or green onion, chopped
Hot honey, optional

Instructions:
Preheat oven to 450°F. Scrub the potato, pat completely dry, then rub with olive oil and season generously with salt. Pierce a few times with a fork and bake directly on the oven rack for 45–60 mins, or until crispy on the outside and completely tender inside
Brush all over with neutral oil and let it bake for another 15 minutes
Thinly slice the red onion. Toss with vinegar, honey & salt, then let sit for at least 10–15 mins while you prepare everything else
Mix Greek yogurt, mayonnaise, Dijon, lemon juice, salt & black pepper until smooth. Set aside
Pat the steak dry & season generously with salt & black pepper. Heat a skillet over high heat, then sear the steak for 2–3 mins per side, depending on thickness & desired doneness
Lower the heat, add butter & garlic, then baste the steak for 30–60 seconds. Remove from the pan & let rest for 5 mins before slicing thinly against the grain
When the potato is done, carefully slice it open lengthwise and gently squeeze the ends to open it up. Fluff the inside with a fork, then add butter and a pinch of salt
Add a little more butter or olive oil to the skillet. Crack in 2 eggs & cook until the whites are set and the edges are crispy while keeping the yolks runny. Season with salt & black pepper
Load the baked potato with the sliced garlic butter steak, creamy Dijon sauce, pickled onions & crispy fried egg
Finish with fresh chives, cracked black pepper & a drizzle of hot honey if desired. Dig in while everything is hot and enjoy immediately.

PS I forgot the creamy Dijon Sauce… but if you make this I would HIGHLY recommend

#bakedpotato #potato #steak #healthyrecipe #dinnerideas

Smoked Salmon Cucumber Salad

Comment “YES” and I’ll send you the FULL recipe!!

Crunchy cucumber, smoky salmon, creamy whipped cottage cheese, capers, fresh dill & everything seasoning… basically a lox bagel turned into a high-protein salad

For the Creamy Cottage Cheese Dressing:
1/2 cup cottage cheese
1 tbsp Greek yogurt
1–2 tsp fresh lemon juice
1 tsp Dijon mustard
1 tsp olive oil
1/2 tsp honey
1 garlic clove
2 tbsp fresh dill
Salt & black pepper, to taste

For the Salad:
2–3 Persian cucumbers, chopped
3–4 oz smoked salmon, torn into bite-sized pieces
1/4 small red onion, very thinly sliced
1 tbsp capers
1/2 avocado, diced
1 tbsp fresh chives, chopped
1–2 tbsp fresh dill, chopped
1 tsp lemon zest
Everything bagel seasoning, to taste

For the Crispy Topping:
1 slice sourdough, cut into small cubes
1 tsp olive oil
Everything bagel seasoning, to taste

Instructions:
Add cottage cheese, Greek yogurt, lemon juice, Dijon, olive oil, honey, garlic, dill, salt & pepper to a blender. Blend until completely smooth & creamy, adding a small splash of water if needed to loosen
Heat a small skillet over medium heat. Toss sourdough cubes with olive oil & everything bagel seasoning, then toast for 3–5 mins, tossing occasionally, until golden & crispy. Set aside
Add the creamy cottage cheese dressing to the bottom of a large container or bowl
Add cucumber, red onion, capers, avocado, chives, dill & lemon zest
Toss everything together until the vegetables are evenly coated in the creamy dressing
Tear the smoked salmon into bite-sized pieces & gently fold it into the salad
Finish with everything bagel seasoning, crispy sourdough breadcrumbs, extra dill & a squeeze of fresh lemon

#healthyrecipe #easyrecipe #cucumbersalad #saladrecipe #salad

Ultimate Breakfast Sandwich

Comment “YES” and I’ll send you the full recipe card for FREE!!

Crispy hash brown, perfectly runny egg, crispy bacon, melty cheese & a homemade breakfast sauce all stacked on a buttery toasted brioche bun… this might be the breakfast sandwich of my dreams

For the Breakfast Sauce:
1/3 cup mayo
2 tbsp ketchup
1 tbsp yellow mustard
1 tbsp hot sauce
1/2 tsp garlic powder
1/2 tsp smoked paprika
Pinch of salt

For the Sandwich:
1 brioche bun
2 eggs
2 slices thick-cut bacon
1 frozen hash brown patty
2 slices American cheese
1 tbsp butter
Breakfast sauce
Salt & black pepper
Fresh chives, finely chopped

Optional Upgrades:
Caramelized onions
Avocado
Jalapeños
Pickled red onions
Maple drizzle

Instructions:
1. Mix together mayo, ketchup, mustard, hot sauce, garlic powder, smoked paprika & salt. Set aside
2. Cook bacon in a skillet over medium heat until deeply crispy. Transfer to a paper towel-lined plate and reserve about 1 tbsp of the bacon fat in the pan
3. Cook the hash brown in the bacon fat according to package directions, pressing it down occasionally, until deeply golden and ridiculously crispy on both sides. Season with a little salt
4. Butter the cut sides of the brioche bun and toast in a skillet until golden brown. Remove and set aside
5. Lower the heat to medium-low and melt a little butter in the pan. Crack in the eggs, season with salt & pepper, and cook until the whites are set but the yolks are still runny. For an extra crispy edge, let the whites spread slightly around the pan
6. Place a slice of American cheese over each egg and cover the pan for 30–60 seconds until the cheese is completely melted
7. Spread a generous layer of breakfast sauce on both sides of the toasted brioche
8. Stack it up: bottom bun → cheesy eggs → crispy hash brown → bacon → optional toppings → more breakfast sauce → top bun
9. Finish with fresh chives, give it a gentle press, slice straight through the middle & get that yolk drizzle

#sandwich #breakfastideas #recipes #foodtiktok #breakfastrecipes

The Ultimate BLT

Comment “YES” and I’ll send you the full recipe WITH INSTRUCTIONS for FREE!!

Thick, crispy toasted bread, juicy salted tomatoes, ridiculous amounts of bacon, crunchy lettuce & a creamy, tangy sauce… this is how a BLT is supposed to be

For the BLT:
2 thick slices sourdough or country white bread
4–6 slices thick-cut bacon
2 large ripe tomatoes
2–3 leaves crisp romaine or iceberg lettuce
1 tbsp butter
1 sunny side up egg
1 avocado
Flaky salt
Freshly cracked black pepper

For the Sauce:
3 tbsp mayonnaise
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 tsp lemon juice
1/2 tsp garlic powder
1/2 tsp smoked paprika
Black pepper, to taste
Pinch of salt

Optional:
1 tsp hot sauce
1 tsp finely chopped chives
A few thin slices of avocado

Instructions:
Slice the tomatoes into thick slices, about 1/2–3/4 inch thick. Lay them on a plate or wire rack, generously season both sides with salt, and let them sit for 10–15 minutes. Gently blot away the excess moisture before building the sandwich
Mix together the mayonnaise, Dijon, lemon juice, garlic powder, smoked paprika, black pepper & salt. Add hot sauce if you want a little kick
Cook the bacon in a skillet over medium heat until deeply browned and crispy around the edges but still slightly chewy in the center. Transfer to a paper towel-lined plate and let the excess grease drain
Butter one side of each slice of bread. Toast butter-side down in a skillet over medium heat until deeply golden and crisp. Flip and toast the other side for another 1–2 minutes
Spread a generous layer of sauce over both slices of toasted bread
Layer on the lettuce, followed by the salted tomato slices. Season the tomatoes with a little freshly cracked black pepper
Pile on a ridiculous amount of bacon, making sure every bite gets some
Top with the second slice of bread, gently press everything together, slice in half & eat immediately
The goal: crispy bread, cold crunchy lettuce, warm salty bacon, juicy tomatoes & enough sauce to make the whole thing completely ridiculous.

#sandwich #sandwiches #recipe #recipes #easyrecipe

Cilantro Lime Steak Fajita Rice Bowl

Comment “YES” and I’ll send you the full recipe card for FREE

Juicy seared steak, charred peppers & onions, creamy homemade guacamole & pico piled over fluffy cilantro lime rice

For the Steak:
5–6 oz flank steak or sirloin
1 tsp olive oil
1 tsp chili powder
½ tsp cumin
½ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp smoked paprika
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper
Juice of ½ lime

For the Fajita Veggies:
½ bell pepper, sliced
½ small red onion, sliced
1 tsp olive oil
½ tsp chili powder
¼ tsp cumin
Salt & black pepper, to taste

For the Bowl:
1 Minute Cilantro & Lime Jasmine Rice Cup
¼ cup pico de gallo
Fresh cilantro
Lime wedges

Killer Homemade Guacamole:
½ ripe avocado
1 tbsp finely diced red onion
1 tbsp finely diced jalapeño
1 tbsp chopped fresh cilantro
Juice of ½ lime
Pinch of salt
¼ tsp cumin

Instructions:
Season the steak with olive oil, chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, smoked paprika, salt, black pepper & lime juice. Let sit for 10–15 minutes while you prep everything else.
Make the guacamole by mashing the avocado with lime juice, red onion, jalapeño, cilantro, cumin & salt. Mix until creamy but still slightly chunky. Taste and adjust with more lime or salt as needed.
Cook the fajita veggies in a hot skillet with olive oil over medium-high heat. Add peppers and onions, season with chili powder, cumin, salt & pepper, and cook for 4–6 minutes until slightly charred but still crisp.
Prepare the Minute Cilantro & Lime Jasmine Rice Cup according to the package instructions.
Sear the steak in a very hot skillet for 2–4 minutes per side, depending on thickness and desired doneness. Let rest for 5 minutes, then slice thinly against the grain.
Build your bowl with the cilantro lime rice as the base, then add fajita veggies, sliced steak, guacamole and pico.
Finish with fresh cilantro and an extra squeeze of lime. Enjoy!!

Crispy Chili Beef Cucumber Salad

Crunchy smashed cucumbers, crispy caramelized beef, creamy avocado & a spicy sesame chili dressing… this is what happens when cucumber salad becomes an actual meal

For the Crispy Beef:
5–6 oz lean ground beef
1 tsp sesame oil
1 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce
1 tsp honey
1 tsp minced garlic
1 tsp fresh ginger, grated
1/2 tsp chili flakes
Salt & black pepper, to taste

For the Salad:
2 Persian cucumbers, smashed & chopped
1/2 avocado, diced
1/4 red onion, thinly sliced
2 tbsp fresh cilantro, chopped
1 green onion, sliced
1 tsp sesame seeds
Optional: 1/2 cup edamame

For the Spicy Lime Yogurt Dressing:
1/3 cup nonfat Greek yogurt
1 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce
1 tbsp rice vinegar
Juice of 1/2 lime
1 tsp honey
1 small garlic clove, grated
1/2–1 tsp sriracha or hot sauce
1/2 tsp sesame oil
1–2 tsp water, as needed
Pinch of salt

Instructions:
Smash the cucumbers with the side of a chef’s knife or rolling pin, then chop into bite-sized pieces. Add to a large bowl with avocado, red onion, cilantro & green onion (or use a mandolin like me).
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Add the ground beef and break it into very small pieces. Let it cook mostly undisturbed for a couple minutes at a time, stirring occasionally, until deeply browned and super crispy.
Add sesame oil, soy sauce, honey, garlic, ginger, chili flakes, salt & pepper. Cook for another 1–2 minutes until the beef is caramelized and crispy. Remove from heat and set aside.
In a small bowl, whisk together the Greek yogurt, soy sauce, rice vinegar, lime juice, honey, garlic, sriracha or hot sauce & sesame oil. Add 1–2 tsp of water and whisk until smooth and drizzleable.
Pour the spicy lime yogurt dressing over the cucumber mixture and toss until everything is evenly coated.
Plate the dressed cucumber salad and pile the crispy beef generously over the top.
Finish with sesame seeds, sliced green onion & an extra squeeze of lime. Enjoy!!

#recipe #easyrecipe #healthyrecipe #recipes

Easy Healthy Shakshuka

Jammy eggs simmered in a rich, garlicky tomato sauce with feta, fresh herbs & warm spices… grab some crusty bread because you’re gonna want to clean the pan

For the Shakshuka:
1 tbsp olive oil
1/2 yellow onion, diced
1 red bell pepper, diced
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 tbsp tomato paste
1 tsp smoked paprika
1/2 tsp cumin
1/2 tsp chili flakes
1 can (28 oz) crushed tomatoes
Salt & black pepper, to taste
5–6 eggs
Feta, crumbled
Fresh parsley or cilantro, chopped
Crusty bread, for serving

Instructions:
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the onion and bell pepper and cook for 5–7 mins until softened.
Add garlic, tomato paste, smoked paprika, cumin & chili flakes. Stir and cook for 1–2 mins until fragrant.
Pour in the crushed tomatoes and season with salt & black pepper. Stir everything together and let simmer for 10–15 mins, stirring occasionally, until the sauce thickens.
Use the back of a spoon to make 5–6 small wells in the sauce. Crack an egg into each well.
Cover the skillet and cook for 5–8 mins, or until the egg whites are set but the yolks are still runny. Cook a little longer if you prefer firmer yolks.
Remove from heat and top with crumbled feta and fresh parsley or cilantro.
Serve immediately with warm, crusty bread for dipping. Enjoy!!

#recipe #easyrecipe #healthyrecipe #recipes #lasagna

Creamy Baked Salmon & Spinach Pasta

Comment “RECIPE” and I’ll send you the full recipe card!!!

Creamy feta, flaky salmon, juicy tomatoes & spinach tossed with pasta… and the best part? It all starts in ONE baking dish

FULL RECIPE CRED: constantinteck

For the Pasta:
350 g pasta

For the Baked Salmon & Feta:
250 g salmon fillet
200 g feta cheese
200 g cherry tomatoes
2 cloves garlic, minced
2 tbsp olive oil
1 tsp Italian herbs
Salt & black pepper, to taste

For Finishing:
2 handfuls baby spinach

Instructions:
Add salmon, feta, cherry tomatoes, garlic, olive oil, Italian herbs, salt & black pepper to a baking dish. Toss the tomatoes and feta lightly to coat.
Bake at 400°F (200°C) for 20–25 mins, until the salmon is cooked through and flakes easily.
Meanwhile, cook the pasta according to the package instructions. Reserve a splash of pasta water, then drain.
Remove the baking dish from the oven. Flake the salmon with a fork and mix everything together until the feta and tomatoes create a creamy sauce.
Add the baby spinach and cooked pasta. Toss everything together until the spinach wilts and the pasta is coated in the sauce. Add a splash of reserved pasta water if needed.
Serve immediately and enjoy!! ❤️

Cucumber Steak Salad 🥩🥒

Comment “RECIPE” and I’ll send you the full recipe card WITH instructions!!

Juicy, perfectly seared steak, crunchy cucumbers, creamy avocado, tomatoes, red onion & feta tossed in a bright garlic-Dijon herb dressing… basically everything you want in a steak salad 🤤

For the Steak:
1 steak (sirloin, NY strip, flank, or your favorite cut) 1 tbsp olive oil 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce 1 tsp Dijon mustard 2 garlic cloves, minced 1/2 tsp smoked paprika 1/2 tsp dried oregano 1/2 tsp kosher salt 1/2 tsp black pepper

For the Salad:
2 Persian cucumbers, quartered 1/2 cup cherry tomatoes, halved 1/4 red onion, very thinly sliced 1/2 avocado, diced 1/4 cup feta cheese, crumbled 2 tbsp fresh parsley, chopped 2 tbsp fresh chives, chopped Optional: crispy chickpeas or crispy onions

For the Garlic Dijon Herb Dressing:
Juice of 1/2 lemon 1 tbsp red wine vinegar 1 tbsp olive oil 1 tsp Dijon mustard 1 tsp honey 1 garlic clove, finely minced 1 tbsp fresh parsley, finely chopped 1 tbsp fresh chives, finely chopped 1/4 tsp dried oregano 1/4 tsp salt Black pepper, to taste

For Topping:
Extra feta Fresh herbs Freshly cracked black pepper Lemon wedges

Instructions:
Marinate the steak: Combine olive oil, Worcestershire sauce, Dijon, garlic, smoked paprika, oregano, salt & pepper. Coat the steak and let it marinate for at least 20–30 minutes.
Make the dressing: Whisk together lemon juice, red wine vinegar, olive oil, Dijon, honey, garlic, herbs, oregano, salt & pepper. Set aside.
Prep the salad: Add cucumbers, cherry tomatoes, red onion, avocado, parsley, chives & feta to a large bowl.
Cook the steak: Heat a cast iron or heavy-bottomed pan over high heat. Pat the steak dry, then sear for 3–5 minutes per side depending on thickness and desired doneness. Cook to your preferred internal temperature.
Rest & slice: Transfer the steak to a cutting board and let it rest for 5–10 minutes. Slice thinly against the grain, then cut into bite-sized pieces.
Toss the salad: Pour the dressing over the salad and gently toss until everything is coated.
Build & serve: Top with the sliced steak, extra feta, fresh herbs & plenty of freshly cracked black pepper. Finish with a squeeze of lemon and enjoy!!
